patch:
--- a/WSCUTOFF.cpy
+++ b/WSCUTOFF.cpy
@@ -4 +4 @@
-           05  WS-CUTOFF-CAP         PIC 9(5) VALUE 6000.
+           05  WS-CUTOFF-CAP         PIC 9(5) VALUE 5000.
rationale: The shared cutoff cap is 6000, but the authorized clause-31 cutoff is the lower of one percent of the credit limit and Rs 5000. Set the cap to 5000 so the existing comparison uses that limit.
intended_behavior: WS-ACTION is CONSENT when the refund exceeds min(one percent of credit limit, Rs 5000), and ADJUST otherwise. Equality does not exceed the cutoff.
